messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing duplicate billing tokens when a streaming connection gets routed mid-stream during the new routing-policy canary. small spike in per-token charge from one customer: https://billing.internal/txn/9342 :grimace:
jordan: repro? steps / logs?
maria: quick repro: start SSE stream -> send ~2k tokens -> flip route (canary) -> client reconnects -> server accepts resume but assigns new session id -> tokens after resume billed again. sample headers on reconnect:
```
GET /stream/resume HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer ...
Resume-Key: rsm_abc123
X-Route-Tag: eu-west-canary
User-Agent: redwood-client/1.4.2
```
infra-bot: deploy/canary infra-stack-7 -> routing-policy v2 started by @deploy-bot at 2026-02-18T11:12:03Z
rahul: quick analysis: resume flow currently trusts Resume-Key but doesn't validate origin_route. if the router moves you to a different cluster where KV ack state isn't shared, server treats resume like a fresh connection and replays the cached prefix -> double token accounting. also telemetry shows different trace_id for pre/post reroute so we can't easily connect them in console.
sophie: console UX note: for affected requests trace_id_before != trace_id_after and there is no route_tag on the resume event, so dashboards don't surface this as a routing-induced duplicate.
jordan: short-term mitigation: refuse resume across route-tag changes. require client to include X-Route-Tag in resume handshake and compare to previous; if mismatch, reject resume and require a fresh cold-start (no replay). less ideal UX but avoids double billing.
maria: agree. long-term: add idempotency token per stream plus last_ack_token so server can dedupe replayed tokens even across clusters.
rahul: pushed a tiny patch that enforces route-tag validation on resume + logs both old_route/new_route for telemetry. patch: 
```
# resume_middleware.go (pseudo)
if resume.Header["X-Route-Tag"] != session.RouteTag {
  log.Info("resume_route_mismatch", "old", session.RouteTag, "new", resume.Header["X-Route-Tag"])
  return http.Error(w, "route changed; resume rejected", 409)
}
```
rahul: also added telemetry field resume.route_mismatch and trace.link_id to connect the two traces in console.
maria: can we roll that to canary ASAP and optionally rollback the routing-policy canary if the fix is nontrivial? customers are asking.
infra-bot: rollback scheduled for infra-stack-7 at 2026-02-18T11:45:00Z (requested by @maria)
jordan: pinging @sophie to add a small dashboard tile: streaming_resume_mismatch rate + top affected tenants, and a console banner when resume is rejected explaining "route changed — reconnecting may replay tokens; a cold restart was required."
sophie: will add.
maria: thanks — once patch is in canary we should repro with the same tenant and confirm no duplicate token events. :thumbsup:
rahul: leaving a follow-up TODO in the PR to add dedupe-by-idempotency token later.
maria: cool. closing loop here for now.
